# Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Please also include relevant motivation and context for your Arduino project or contribution.

- **Project Name:** 
- **Target Board (e.g., Arduino Uno, Nano, ESP32):** 
- **Related Issue (if any):** fixes #

---

## Type of Change
Please check the options that apply:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature / New Arduino Project (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

---

## Checklist
Before submitting your Pull Request, please ensure you have met the following requirements:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`.clang-format`, `.editorconfig`).
- [ ] I have tested my code/project on actual hardware or a reliable simulator.
- [ ] I have added a clear `README.md` inside my project folder with wiring, pinouts, and instructions.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or compilation errors.
- [ ] I have read and followed the rules specified in `Rank/CONCURSE.txt`.

---

## Screenshots or Wiring Diagram (Optional)
If applicable, add screenshots, photos of your circuit, or ASCII/markdown wiring diagrams to help reviewers understand your project!
